decisions.reason: The page-limit impact is already fully captured by the candidate's message 91 MODIFY, including the revised compliance goal and spacing-based layout compaction.
The one-page letter target is established by a separate clause in message 91 and is already captured; the streamlined full-document treatment does not change that target.
Using consistent layouts and fewer custom treatments does not change the Agua Arc brand identity, color source, or logo source.
The streamlined layout approach does not cancel or alter the requirement to incorporate the organization chart into the final draft.
The source decision changes general page treatment and spacing but does not change table inclusion or the two supplied table replacements.
Fewer section-specific layout treatments do not change which photos must be included or the asterisk-based selection rule.
Decreasing paragraph and section spacing does not change the required typeface or font-size consistency rules.
The client only offers to consider trimming content during later review; no supplied narrative content is currently removed or made optional.
Consistent page layouts and reduced spacing do not alter the mandatory section order or permit section reordering.
The source decision does not change the biography count, appendix location, or direct-insertion and placeholder fallback method.
The streamlined design and spacing changes do not remove or otherwise modify the table-of-contents requirement.
The revised visual and spacing approach does not change the requirement to deliver a print-ready PDF.
